headline: Nearly Half of Mexican Companies Report US Tariffs Affect Cost Structures
summary: A survey shows that nearly 50% of Mexican businesses report that US trade tariffs are impacting their cost structures. Despite this, most firms plan to continue expanding international trade and adopting long-term mitigation strategies.
why: Mexico is one of the largest trading partners of the United States under the USMCA trade framework.

impacts.name: Mexico
impacts.why: Nearly half of Mexican firms face higher costs due to US trade tariffs.
